messages:
anya: opened a PR with two compact provisioning examples: one for reserved pools and one for burst (https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4599). goal: make it clear when to pick reserved vs burst and show tiny CLI + SDK snippets.

sam: on it. can we avoid `threshold_pct` name? we've got `target_utilization_pct` in autoscale docs.

marta: agree. also add a one-liner about eviction risk for burst pools and link to eviction-model.

kevin: adding SDK snippet for tenant label + policy attach. draft: `client.provision_capacity(tenant="team-zen", pool_type="burst", policy={"target_utilization_pct":75, "cooldown_seconds":300})`

anya: perfect. sam, can you add CLI example for tenant admins? suggestion: `redwoodctl capacity set-policy --tenant team-zen --type burst --target 75 --cooldown 300`

sam: will push CLI + tiny smoke test. also adding SLA blurb: reserved pools = stable latency SLA; burst = cost-friendly but preemptible (no latency SLA guarantee). two bullets under tradeoffs.

docs-bot: Style reminder: examples <= 15 lines, param links, present tense.

marta: small copy nit: use `cooldown_seconds` consistently in YAML and SDK.

anya: thanks — once edits are in i'll merge. tagging @kevin to confirm SDK snippet formatting. merge target: next docs deploy.
